reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing DeepSeek Harness WebUI utility that centralizes and customizes keyboard shortcuts for existing app actions. README describes 34 predefined features across session, view, clipboard, model, permission, and system groups, plus recording, conflict checks, diagnostics, and localStorage persistence, while package metadata marks it as a DSH web client plugin, confirming its role as an end-user interface utility extension.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness WebUI 键盘快捷键插件，为会话、视图、剪贴板、模型和权限等操作提供可自定义的热键绑定、快捷键管理页与速查面板。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that adds customizable keyboard shortcuts for session, view, clipboard, model, and permission actions, with binding management and a shortcut reference panel.

capabilities: Captures keyboard input in the DeepSeek Harness WebUI and maps combos to predefined actions
Supports user-defined shortcut recording, enable/disable toggles, clearing, and conflict checking
Stores shortcut configuration in browser localStorage for persistence across reloads
Invokes DeepSeek Harness client/runtime services for UI, session, theme, locale, model, and model-control actions
Provides an optional host-side permission preset toggle path through platform integration
